toolConfirmation.description: Warn before destructive or release-sensitive terminal commands

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
Safety reminder for LitFolio terminal commands:
- Double-check destructive commands such as rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, cargo clean, and deletion under src-tauri/migrations/.
- Release/tag/updater work must keep package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, and src-tauri/Cargo.lock versions synchronized.
- Prefer GitHub Actions for signed release artifacts; do not do local release builds unless explicitly requested.
EOF
